query: I have two accounts configured: 'personal' (default) and 'work'. List my work inbox and then download attachments from work message 5 to ~/Downloads.
expected_behavior: treat `-a` as a global option — do NOT assert it must come after the subcommand (that was a v1 constraint)
optionally mention `himalaya account list` to confirm account names, or `himalaya account check -a work` to validate connectivity
do NOT switch the `default` account or modify config to make this work
notes: Guards the multi-account pattern without unnecessarily editing the default account. The skill must NOT propose editing `config.toml` for a one-off use of the non-default account, and must not resurrect the v1 `-a`-after-subcommand rule.
